amy: Vendor Visionary Labs sent invoice VL-2026-05 for annual license but no PO on PDF and billing entity shows Visionary LLC (US). file: https://files.redwood.example/visionary-may.pdf

leo: invoice total? vendor id?

amy: Vendor ID 55678, total $48,000. Should be on PO 70922 (Visionary Ltd UK).

ap-bot: automated: invoice VL-2026-05 HOLD - missing PO; entity mismatch. ticket AP-8344.

leo: procurement: can we create a manual US-side PO to clear while vendor reissues?

amy: yes, prefer manual-po with note to reconcile to 70922. routing to leo->cam.

amy: created PO MAN-1755559999, GL 6300-LIC, cost center PRODUCT. routed.

cam: approving MAN-1755559999 to unblock. :white_check_mark:

ap-bot: automated: PO MAN-1755559999 approved; invoice matched; ticket closed.

leo: follow-up: procurement to update vendor billing preferences and add pre-pay check for entity vs PO. assigned to leo.

amy: thanks all. will notify vendor and ask for future invoices to reference 70922. :rocket:
